summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 changes (A flour in coloured recipes, B linked tools in SiteMenu + Lab pages, C Miglioratore wording) on the preview URL as admin@mikilab.de. All three verified PASS via Playwright. Backend testing skipped as requested (DB check only, read-only, to confirm flour_grams/water_grams on coloured recipes).

ui_bugs.issue: Result box has WHITE background with near-white text (color rgb(224,213,207)) in dark theme → text is effectively invisible. Content exists ('Impasto totale necessario 3300 g ...') but unreadable. Reproduced by opening related-tool-pizzeria-stampi.

Tools listed in the 'Strumenti collegati' subgroup reuse the SAME data-testid as their primary category entry (site-menu-tool-<id> appears twice in the DOM). Strict-mode selectors break; suggest site-menu-related-tool-<cat>-<id>.

React hydration warnings in console: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' inside [data-testid=ricette-page], and '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in the header language selector. No crash, but invalid HTML nesting.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple 401 console errors on first load (calls fired before session exists). Cosmetic but noisy.

issues: Output card uses white background inside the dark theme (orange text on white) - readable but visually inconsistent with the rest of the dark UI

action_items: Fix contrast of [data-testid='stampi-pirottini-out'] (white bg + near-white text = unreadable in dark theme)
Make related-tool testids unique in SiteMenu (site-menu-related-tool-<cat>-<id>)
Fix nested <button> in Ricette page and <span> inside <option> in language selector (hydration warnings)
critical_code_review_comments: RelatedToolsRow returns null when onOpenTool is missing - silent no-op; consider a dev warning so a missing prop doesn't hide the whole row.
SiteMenu related list filters tl.cat !== c.key which is correct, but ToolRow testid collision makes the related items indistinguishable in tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios passed (A, B1, B2, C, regression)
